hypothesis: In single-document screening, an unresolved criterion can retain resource references for available operands but lack an explicit partial sentence list.
split: 134 original TrialGPT assignments, 44 subjects. No reference labels used.
controls: The pre-change normal screener had no partial_source_sentences key on the age/sex and GCS cases. All five R18 tests passed after the change.

The regression checks the already-cited conditional gate for 26, deduplicates age and sex on one line for 454, and links the total GCS to line 5 for 460. The field is omitted for 467 (no evidence), 481 (group) and 517 (definitive).

The separate encounter screener already returned two documents at their respective line 0, with a distinct DocumentReference and SHA-256 for each. RR 19/min and PaCO2 40 mmHg left the ventilation alternative unresolved. All three encounter CLI tests passed.
replay: From the candidate_v2 source snapshot, run git apply experiments/strict_evidence/receipts/03-partial-source.patch and python3.11 -B experiments/strict_evidence/predict.py /tmp/new-partial-freeze. Compare predictions.json to candidate_v2/predictions.json after removing only decision.partial_source_sentences.
disposition: Eight abstaining criteria explicitly expose their partial source lines. Seven previously had an empty criterion-level source_sentences list. Case 26 already cited its conditional gate. No criterion changed state.
